headline: Senators Back 3 PM Impeachment Hearings to Balance Trial and Legislative Work
seoTitle: Senators Back 3 PM Impeachment Trial Schedule | FMB News
seoDescription: Senator-judges have backed moving impeachment hearings to afternoon sessions, according to the approved FMB News brief, as the Senate balances trial proceedings with legislative work.
deck: The approved newsroom brief says senator-judges reached broad support for afternoon hearings beginning Monday, leaving mornings for regular Senate work.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Senator-judges have broadly backed shifting the Vice President's impeachment trial to 3:00 PM afternoon hearings beginning Monday, August 24, according to the approved FMB News overnight brief.

The brief attributes the scheduling consensus to consultations among Senate leaders and the parties to the trial. The arrangement is intended to preserve morning hours for plenary and committee work while reserving afternoons for impeachment proceedings.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Senate is simultaneously handling its ordinary legislative calendar and its constitutional role as an impeachment court. A later trial start would separate those functions more clearly during sitting days.
The brief also reports discussion of possible Friday hearings. FMB News is treating that element as under discussion until formally adopted rather than as a settled calendar rule.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Scheduling affects both the pace of the impeachment case and the Senate's ability to process legislation, including budget work. Longer or additional hearing days could accelerate witness presentation without eliminating regular legislative sessions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the Senate's formal Monday calendar, the actual opening time of the impeachment court and any decision on Friday hearings or other changes to the trial timetable.
